premises.text: App users need data continuity across devices, but existing backends (iCloud-only, self-built months+storage, or expensive BaaS at scale) fail developers who want cross-platform apps
premises.evidence_span: lack of data continuity across devices

premises.text: Nimbus Base/Space is a mobile/web backend that stores app data in users' personal clouds (Dropbox, Google Drive) with local-first offline sync and few lines of developer code
premises.evidence_span: the first mobile and web backend to leverage app users' personal clouds, like Dropbox and Google Drive, to store app data

premises.text: Users keep complete control and can personally delete app data from their cloud, unlike opaque server-side deletes
premises.evidence_span: you can personally delete your data for your apps

premises.text: Building on personal-cloud APIs removes the developer's server: backend setup minutes not months, and scale from one to millions with no developer storage costs
premises.evidence_span: we completely remove the server from the app development equation

domains.name: minutes and free scale for developers

value.text: Users get recent app data anytime anywhere across devices while developers avoid owning backends
value.evidence_span: data continuity across devices and lets you have complete control over all your data

secondary_value.text: Developers save months of backend work and scale without storage costs
secondary_value.evidence_span: reduces the time developers spend setting up a back end from months to minutes

causal_links.evidence_span: app users expect to have access to their most recent data anytime, anywhere
data is instantly synced between the two
scale from one user to millions for free

notes: iCloud/self-build/BaaS alternatives folded into one backend-gap problem with continuity need (§4.1.6). TweetDart demo, offline local-then-sync, and Dropbox folder visibility folded as personal-cloud backend cascade (§4.1.7); user delete/control kept as security package of that backend. Time+money developer benefits folded as one economics premise of removing the server. ASR Nimbus Space/Base variants left in spans. Three domains; not a need/product/money triad.
